cover_letter:
Dear Testachats team,

I am excited to apply for the Webmaster position at Testachats. Your mission to inform, advise, and defend consumers resonates with me, and I am eager to bring my digital expertise to support your impactful work.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I build and maintain client websites in WordPress, manage content publishing, and troubleshoot CMS issues. I create and update landing pages, blog posts, and other web content, ensuring they display correctly and are user-friendly. I also write keyword-targeted content and run on-page SEO, which has improved organic visibility for client sites. This hands-on experience has made me comfortable with HTML and CSS, and I enjoy helping colleagues solve CMS problems and become more independent.

On my personal project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data, and conducted technical SEO audits. This project sharpened my ability to manage complex web pages, maintain content accuracy, and improve site performance. I am also curious about new technologies, including AI, and have applied AI-assisted tools to content creation and optimization.

I meet the language requirements: English is my professional language, Turkish is native, and my Dutch is at B1 level, which I am actively improving. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and open to working near Brussels-South. I am a proactive problem-solver who enjoys collaborating with editors, designers, and developers.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Testachats' digital publishing processes and support your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
